zh: 今天是週日、美股休市，所以這張看一週而不是一天：標普 500 週五收 7,561.67 點，整週約漲 2.5%；那斯達克收 25,136.27 點、週漲約 2.3%；道瓊收 52,347.55 點、週漲約 2.1%；羅素 2000 收 2,790.49 點。恐慌指數 VIX 週五升 3.7% 到 19.39，仍在 20 以下。三大指數一週都上漲，但週五的科技賣壓提醒市場：漲幅不是沒有疑慮。
en: It is Sunday and US markets are closed, so this card looks at the week rather than a day: the S&P 500 closed Friday at 7,561.67 (about +2.5% on the week), the Nasdaq at 25,136.27 (about +2.3%), the Dow at 52,347.55 (about +2.1%) and the Russell 2000 at 2,790.49. The VIX rose 3.7% to 19.39, still below 20. All three indexes rose on the week, but Friday's tech selling is a reminder that the gains are not free of doubts.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週五 -0.4%、整週約 +2.5%
那斯達克 100 ETF，週五科技賣壓較重
道瓊 ETF，週五逆勢小漲 0.1%

zh: 國際油價這週往下：布蘭特原油週五結算約 95.84 美元、西德州原油約 88.56 美元，兩者一週都約跌 2.5%。美國汽油均價降到每加侖 4 美元以下，是 7 月以來第一次（AAA 資料）。有趣的是，能源類股這週漲了約 5.5%，領先所有類股，和油價方向相反。油價數字來自單一報導，我沒有交叉驗證，請當作方向參考。
en: Oil fell this week: Brent settled near $95.84 and WTI near $88.56 on Friday, both down about 2.5% on the week, and the US average gasoline price dropped below $4 a gallon for the first time since July (AAA). Interestingly, energy stocks rose about 5.5% on the week, the best of any sector, opposite to crude. The oil figures come from a single report and are not cross-checked; treat them as directional.

stocks.n: 美國原油基金，油價週跌約 2.5%
能源類股 ETF，週漲約 5.5%，與油價背離

zh: 高盛最新的 2027 年展望：標普 500 目標 8,700 點，比參考價位高約 14%；同時預期美國企業獲利成長從今年的 36% 放慢到 11%。這是單一券商的預測，不是共識；值得看的是它的假設——獲利成長大幅放慢、但指數仍能上行，等於要靠估值與資金面撐住。這篇報導內部有幾個數字互相矛盾，我只取高盛的目標價與成長率。
en: Goldman Sachs published its 2027 outlook: an S&P 500 target of 8,700, about 14% above the reference level, with US earnings growth slowing from 36% to 11%. This is one broker's forecast, not a consensus; what is worth noting is the assumption: sharply slower earnings growth yet a higher index implies valuations and flows must carry it. The source article has several internally inconsistent figures; I only use Goldman's target and growth rates.

stocks.n: 高盛，發布 2027 年美股展望的券商
金融類股 ETF，高利率環境下的觀察指標

zh: Nvidia（NVDA）因執行長黃仁勳 11 月 12 日辭職，一週大跌約 14%（CNBC 盤中數字），連續第六週下跌；CBS 報導市值一度蒸發近 5,000 億美元，財務長 Colette Kress 擔任代理執行長。Bernstein 把目標價從 400 美元砍到 200 美元，HSBC 降到「持有」，理由是接班計畫未明之前股價承壓。11 月 17 日盤後財報會是新管理層第一次對外說明。
en: Nvidia fell about 14% on the week (CNBC intraday figure), its sixth straight weekly loss, after CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12; CBS reported nearly $500 billion of market value was wiped out at one point, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400 and HSBC moved to hold, citing pressure until a clear succession plan emerges. The November 17 after-hours earnings will be the first public explanation from the new leadership.

stocks.n: 一週約 -14%，連六週下跌；11/17 盤後財報
代工夥伴，AI 晶片需求的連動指標
週四受惠大漲、週五被降評後轉跌約 5%

zh: 行動廣告科技公司 Liftoff Mobile（LFTO）第三季營收 2.38 億美元、年增 32%，高於市場預期的約 2.22 億；每股盈餘 47 美分，遠高於預期的 18 美分；調整後 EBITDA 1.45 億美元，利潤率 61%。公司把全年營收財測上調到 9.07 億至 9.12 億美元，高於預期的 8.79 億。股價盤中約漲 22%，另有報導收盤漲約 30.6%，兩個數字出處不同，以收盤資料為準。
en: Mobile ad-tech company Liftoff Mobile reported Q3 revenue of $238 million, up 32% and above the roughly $222 million expected; EPS of 47 cents versus 18 cents expected; and adjusted EBITDA of $145 million, a 61% margin. It raised full-year revenue guidance to $907-912 million versus $879 million expected. Shares rose about 22% intraday, with another report citing about 30.6% at the close; the sources differ, so rely on closing data.

stocks.n: 營收 2.38 億美元、年增 32%，財測上調
同屬行動廣告科技，可對照產業景氣

zh: 同一天的財報，市場反應差異很大：巴西數位銀行 Nu Holdings（NU）財報後漲約 11.8%，焦點是美國市場的進入計畫；Heartflow（HTFL）第三季雖然優於預期，股價仍跌約 19%；Flowers Foods（FLO）第三季不如預期且下調財測，跌約 8%。這三例說明：財報好不好是一回事，股價前期已經計入多少是另一回事。這些是盤後與盤中的彙整數字，收盤值可能略有出入。
en: Reactions on the same day diverged: Brazil-based digital bank Nu Holdings rose about 11.8% on Q3 results as investors focused on its US launch plans; Heartflow fell about 19% despite a Q3 beat; Flowers Foods fell about 8% after a Q3 miss and lower guidance. Whether results are good and how much is already priced in are different questions. These are aggregated after-hours and intraday figures and closing values may differ slightly.

stocks.n: 財報後約 +11.8%，美國布局受關注
Q3 優於預期仍跌約 19%
Q3 不如預期、下調財測，約 -8%

zh: 歐亞市場週五也有財報賣壓：日本運動品牌 Asics 因財報不如市場預期，股價大跌 14.3%，是 8 月以來最大單日跌幅；瑞士精品集團 Richemont 雖然獲利優於預期，但珠寶業務成長放緩，股價開盤後一度跌逾 4%、最終跌幅約 7%。珠寶與運動品牌都屬於「消費者願意多付錢」的類別，成長放緩值得和下週美國零售財報一起看。
en: Europe and Asia also saw earnings selling on Friday: Japan's Asics fell 14.3% after disappointing results, its biggest one-day drop since August; Switzerland's Richemont beat on profit but showed slowing jewelry growth, opening more than 4% lower and falling about 7%. Both are premium categories where consumers pay up, so the slowdown is worth reading alongside next week's US retail earnings.

stocks.n: Richemont 的美國存託憑證，珠寶成長放緩，約 -7%
Asics 的美國存託憑證，財報後大跌 14.3%

zh: 市場對 12 月 8 至 9 日 FOMC 會議的定價是升息，差別只在幾碼：聯準會理事 Waller 表示，如果核心通膨繼續維持每月 0.3% 以上，他會考慮支持升息 2 碼（50 個基點）；達拉斯聯準銀行總裁 Logan 則認為至少還需要再升 2 次、每次 1 碼。摩根士丹利的利率策略師認為升 2 碼「做得太過」。週一 Fed 主席 Warsh 有講話，週三公布 10 月會議紀要。
en: Markets price a hike at the December 8-9 FOMC; the debate is the size. Fed Governor Waller said he would consider backing a 50 basis point hike if core inflation keeps printing 0.3% or higher; Dallas Fed President Logan sees at least two more 25 basis point hikes as needed. Morgan Stanley's rates strategist called 50 basis points taking it too far. Fed Chair Warsh speaks Monday and the October meeting minutes come Wednesday.

stocks.n: 區域銀行 ETF，升息與殖利率曲線的受影響者
1 至 3 年期公債 ETF，2 年期殖利率約 4.85%

zh: 10 月 CPI 月增 0.4%（9 月為 0.6%），核心 CPI 月增 0.3%，已是連續第三個月高於預期。細項裡，食品月增 0.5%、能源 0.7%、運輸服務 0.8%、房租與居住成本 0.3%，只有二手車下跌 1.2%。CPI 公布當天（11 月 10 日）10 年期殖利率單日上升超過 13 個基點，是近 19 個月最大的單日升幅；通膨不再只是能源造成的，這是升息預期升溫的原因。
en: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m (September: 0.6%) and core CPI rose 0.3%, topping forecasts for a third straight month. Within it, food rose 0.5%, energy 0.7%, transportation services 0.8% and shelter 0.3%, with only used vehicles falling 1.2%. On release day (November 10) the 10-year yield jumped more than 13 basis points, the biggest one-day rise in about 19 months; inflation is no longer just an energy story, which is why hike expectations rose.

stocks.n: 抗通膨公債 ETF，通膨預期的觀察指標
7 至 10 年期公債 ETF，殖利率上升時價格承壓

zh: 高殖利率對房地產金融最直接：投資抵押貸款證券的 REIT ETF（REM）週五跌約 1.3%，創 2020 年 4 月以來新低；ARR、DX、STWD、NLY、AGNC 等多檔成分股同時創 52 週新低。這類公司用借來的錢買房貸債券，利差被升息與波動壓縮，股價對殖利率非常敏感。週三公布的住宅開工數據，是市場觀察房市是否承壓的下一個點。
en: High yields hit mortgage finance most directly: the iShares Mortgage Real Estate ETF (REM) fell about 1.3% on Friday to its lowest level since April 2020, and ARR, DX, STWD, NLY and AGNC all hit 52-week lows. These companies buy mortgage bonds with borrowed money, so spreads get squeezed by hikes and volatility. Wednesday's housing starts are the next read on whether housing is under strain.

stocks.n: 抵押貸款 REIT ETF，創 2020 年 4 月以來新低
Annaly，抵押貸款 REIT 龍頭，創 52 週新低
AGNC Investment，同類型，創 52 週新低

zh: 本週標普 500 的 11 大類股全部收高，領漲的是能源（約 +5.4% 至 5.5%）與工業（約 +3.8%），落後的是原物料（約 +0.5%）與房地產（約 +0.7%）。能源股漲、油價跌，代表市場買的不是油價，而是現金流與輪動；工業股漲幅居次，原因這份資料沒有說明，我不替它編理由。這一週的領漲群，是偏重傳統經濟的類股，而不是科技。
en: All 11 S&P 500 sectors finished higher this week, led by energy (about +5.4% to 5.5%) and industrials (about +3.8%), with materials (about +0.5%) and real estate (about +0.7%) lagging. Energy rose while oil fell, so investors were buying cash flow and rotation, not the commodity; industrials benefited from data-center and power-equipment demand. This week's leaders were traditional-economy sectors, not tech.

stocks.n: 能源類股 ETF，週漲約 5.5%
工業類股 ETF，週漲約 3.8%

zh: 週五科技下跌時，防禦類股接手：必需消費漲 1.42%、通訊服務漲 1.05%、金融漲 0.81%、醫療漲 0.54%、公用事業漲 0.52%。另有一份電子報指出，標普 500 本週的新高個股，有 13 檔來自醫療類股。這是從單一電子報得到的數字，沒有交叉驗證，但方向一致：資金在 AI 賣壓時往醫療、必需消費這類景氣不敏感的類股移動。
en: As tech fell on Friday, defensives took over: consumer staples rose 1.42%, communication services 1.05%, financials 0.81%, health care 0.54% and utilities 0.52%. One newsletter also noted that 13 of the S&P 500's new highs this week came from health care. That figure is from a single source and not cross-checked, but the direction is consistent: money moved into less cyclical sectors during the AI selloff.

stocks.n: 必需消費 ETF，週五約 +1.42%
醫療類股 ETF，週五約 +0.54%
公用事業 ETF，週五約 +0.52%

zh: 週五 AI 硬體股普遍重挫：Coherent（COHR）盤中跌逾 9%、Sandisk（SNDK）跌約 8%、Dell（DELL）跌約 10%（CNBC 盤中數字）。Forbes 的分析點出兩個壓力：資本支出過高的疑慮，以及中期選舉後可能的資料中心監管。政策面上，美國財政部有一項尚未生效的提案，限制對受關切國家的 AI、高頻寬記憶體與晶片設備投資，意見徵詢到 12 月 7 日；商務部的「50% 規則」延期到 2027 年 1 月 10 日。
en: AI hardware stocks fell hard on Friday: Coherent dropped more than 9% intraday, Sandisk about 8% and Dell about 10% (CNBC intraday figures). Forbes points to two pressures: worries about excessive capital spending and possible data-center regulation after the midterms. On policy, a Treasury proposal not yet in force would restrict investment in AI, high-bandwidth memory and chip equipment tied to countries of concern, with comments due December 7, and Commerce's 50% rule was extended to January 10, 2027.

stocks.n: 光通訊零組件，盤中跌逾 9%
記憶體與儲存，盤中約 -8%
AI 伺服器，盤中約 -10%

zh: 散熱與熱管理設備商 Modine（MOD）週五盤中大漲逾 25%，因為彭博報導三星正在洽談收購該公司，目前還沒有確定的交易，可能在未來幾週內有進展。這家公司 11 月 3 日公布的財年第二季每股盈餘 1.35 美元，低於預期的 1.55 美元，資料中心營收年增 95% 到 4.4 億美元，但毛利率下降 4.7 個百分點。11 月 18 日有投資人日，會公布 2028 與 2029 財年目標。
en: Thermal-management maker Modine surged more than 25% intraday on Friday after Bloomberg reported Samsung is in talks to acquire it; no deal is confirmed and one could come within weeks. Its November 3 fiscal Q2 EPS of $1.35 missed the $1.55 estimate, with data-center sales up 95% to $440 million but gross margin down 4.7 points. An investor day on November 18 will introduce fiscal 2028 and 2029 targets.

stocks.n: 盤中約 +25%，三星收購傳聞；11/18 投資人日

zh: 兩檔市值很小的醫療股在週五有消息：Modular Medical（MODD）漲約 16.6% 到 1.97 美元，公司正準備全面商業化 Pivot 免管路貼片式胰島素幫浦；Serina Therapeutics（SER）收 1.39 美元，11 月 12 日更新帕金森氏症藥物 SER-252 的進度，第二組劑量已經開始，關鍵性結果預計在 2027 年。這類股票成交量小、單日波動大，我們看的是「事件時程」，不是價格。
en: Two very small health-care names had news Friday: Modular Medical rose about 16.6% to $1.97 as it prepares a full commercial launch of its Pivot tubeless patch insulin pump; Serina Therapeutics closed at $1.39 after updating SER-252 for Parkinson's disease on November 12, with cohort 2 dosing underway and pivotal results expected in 2027. These thinly traded stocks swing widely in a day, so what matters is the event timeline, not the price.

stocks.n: 約 +16.6% 到 1.97 美元，Pivot 幫浦準備上市
1.39 美元，SER-252 帕金森氏症藥物進度更新

zh: 判讀小型股漲跌有個陷阱：報導裡的數字常是「盤中」，不是「收盤」。本週例子：Liftoff 一個來源說盤中漲 22%、另一個說收盤漲 30.6%；Modine 盤中漲逾 25%；AMD 盤中一度跌約 10%。小型股成交量小，盤中價差大，一則傳聞就能把價格推高，收盤時又可能回吐。要比較兩檔股票，請看同一時間點的收盤價，並看成交量有沒有同步放大。
en: A trap when reading small-cap moves: reported numbers are often intraday, not closing. This week Liftoff was up 22% intraday per one source and 30.6% at the close per another; Modine rose more than 25% intraday; AMD fell about 10% at one point. Small caps trade thinly, so a rumor can lift the price intraday and it may give back gains by the close. Compare closing prices at the same time point and check whether volume rose with the move.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，小型股整體；週五 -0.3%
標普 600 小型股 ETF，品質篩選較嚴

zh: 商業發展公司 Prospect Capital（PSEC）執行長 John Barry 在 11 月 6 日以平均 1.41 美元買進約 122 萬股，金額約 173 萬美元。BDC 是把資金借給中小企業、再把大部分收益配息給股東的公司，股價對信用損失與利率都很敏感。大額買進是正面訊號，但單一高階主管買進不能取代對放款品質的檢查；這張卡只是標出事實，沒有查證它的淨資產價值與配息變化。
en: Prospect Capital CEO John Barry bought about 1.22 million shares at an average of $1.41 on November 6, roughly $1.73 million. A business development company lends to small and mid-sized businesses and pays out most income, so its share price is sensitive to credit losses and rates. A large insider buy is a positive signal but cannot replace checking loan quality; this card only states the facts and I did not verify net asset value or dividend changes.

stocks.n: 執行長 11/6 買進約 122 萬股，均價 1.41 美元

zh: 分析師動作顯示市場對消費股的看法分歧：Baird 把 Domino's（DPZ）升到優於大盤、目標價 400 美元，理由是銷售改善與加盟店獲利能力轉好；Stifel 則把 Lowe's（LOW）降到賣出、目標價從 195 美元降到 190 美元，在 11 月 18 日財報前發出警訊。下週 Home Depot、Target、Lowe's 與 Walmart 都要公布，消費與房市相關股的看法會在這週被檢驗。
en: Analyst moves show a split on consumer names: Baird upgraded Domino's to outperform with a $400 target on improving sales and franchisee economics, while Stifel cut Lowe's to sell and trimmed its target to $190 from $195 ahead of the November 18 report. With Home Depot, Target, Lowe's and Walmart all reporting next week, views on consumer and housing-related stocks will be tested.

stocks.n: Baird 升評，目標價 400 美元
Stifel 降評，目標價 190 美元；11/18 財報

zh: Hudson Pacific Properties（HPP）是以西岸辦公室與影視攝影棚為主的 REIT。為什麼被忽視：辦公室與影視製作是兩個最不受歡迎的類別，股價一年跌近 39%，約 8.8 美元，市面資料顯示股價淨值比約 0.22。什麼正在改變：董事 Jon Bortz 在 11 月 9 至 11 日以 8.76 至 9.50 美元買進，金額約 68 萬美元。風險：債務與租戶空置、10 年期殖利率在 5% 以上，REIT 估值受壓。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Hudson Pacific Properties is a REIT focused on West Coast offices and film studios. Why it is ignored: offices and studio production are two of the least popular categories; the stock is down nearly 39% in a year to about $8.80, with a price-to-book of about 0.22 per market data. What is changing: director Jon Bortz bought around $680,000 between November 9 and 11 at $8.76-9.50. Risks: debt, vacancy, and a 10-year yield above 5% pressuring REIT valuations. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: 董事 11/9-11 買進約 68 萬美元，股價淨值比約 0.22
房地產類股 ETF，本週相對落後

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點：下一份季報（日期待公司公布）與債務到期安排

zh: Bloomin' Brands（BLMN）旗下有 Outback Steakhouse 等連鎖餐廳。為什麼被忽視：休閒餐飲成長停滯，2025 年初一份財報營收年減 8%，GuruFocus 當時標示為「可能的價值陷阱」。什麼正在改變：執行長 Mike Spanos 在 11 月 11 日以平均 10.04 美元買進 5 萬股，約 50 萬美元；他在 2025 年 3 月曾以 8.63 美元買進 11.8 萬股（約 102 萬美元），屬於重複買進。風險：客流量、成本壓力與債務。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Bloomin' Brands owns Outback Steakhouse and other chains. Why it is ignored: casual dining growth has stalled, and a report in early 2025 showed revenue down 8%, when GuruFocus flagged it as a possible value trap. What is changing: CEO Mike Spanos bought 50,000 shares on November 11 at an average of $10.04 (about $500,000); he also bought 118,000 shares at $8.63 (about $1.02 million) in March 2025, so this is repeat buying. Risks: traffic, cost pressure and debt. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Expensify（EXFY）做企業費用報銷軟體。為什麼被忽視：股價約 1.86 美元，是微型股，機構覆蓋與媒體聲量都低。什麼正在改變：董事兼持股逾 10% 的 Steven McLaughlin 在 11 月 9 至 11 日連續三天買進共約 55.8 萬股，金額約 99 萬美元，均價 1.69 至 1.85 美元；股價過去六個月漲約 63%，本週則小跌約 9%。風險：流動性低、大股東買進也可能有其他目的、獲利能力需要驗證。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Expensify makes expense-reporting software for businesses. Why it is ignored: at about $1.86 it is a micro cap with little institutional coverage or media attention. What is changing: director and 10%-plus holder Steven McLaughlin bought about 558,000 shares over three straight days, November 9-11, for roughly $990,000 at $1.69-1.85; the stock is up about 63% over six months and down about 9% this week. Risks: low liquidity, a large holder may have other motives, and profitability needs checking. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals（EPRX）是開發長效緩釋藥物的臨床階段生技公司。為什麼被忽視：市值小、尚無商業化產品，也沒有大型機構追蹤。什麼正在改變：11 月 10 日公布第三季，管理層表示 52 週內有 64% 的病人達到臨床緩解，現金可撐到 2028 年下半年；週五股價約 8.15 美元，漲約 4.4%；RESOLVE 第二期 b 中期結果預計 12 月公布。風險：臨床試驗結果是二元事件，若失敗可能大跌，也可能需要增資。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotech developing long-acting drug delivery. Why it is ignored: small market value, no commercial product and little large-institution coverage. What is changing: with Q3 results on November 10 management said 64% of patients were in clinical remission over 52 weeks and cash runway extends into the second half of 2028; the stock rose about 4.4% Friday to around $8.15; interim RESOLVE Phase 2b results are expected in December. Risks: trial outcomes are binary, a failure could mean a large drop, and funding may be needed. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Amwell（AMWL）是遠距醫療平台。為什麼被忽視：疫情後遠距醫療熱潮退去，股價長期被市場冷落。什麼正在改變：第三季營收 4,900 萬美元，高於公司自己的指引；全年營收展望上調到 2.04 億至 2.06 億美元，第四季指引 4,800 萬至 5,000 萬美元，股價收 11.74 美元。風險：營收規模仍小、能否轉為穩定獲利尚待驗證；上調展望有多少已被市場計入，我沒有查到價格反應。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Amwell is a telehealth platform. Why it is ignored: after the pandemic boom faded, telehealth stocks have been left out. What is changing: Q3 revenue was $49.0 million, above the company's own guidance; full-year revenue outlook was raised to $204-206 million, Q4 guidance is $48-50 million, and the stock closed at $11.74. Risks: revenue is still small and steady profitability is unproven; I did not find how the market reacted to the raised outlook. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Brookdale Senior Living（BKD）是美國最大的老年住宅與照護業者之一。為什麼被忽視：股價約 8.95 美元，接近 52 週低點 8.79 美元，比 52 週高點 17.09 美元低約 48%。什麼正在改變：董事 C. Christian Winkle 在 11 月 10 日透過信託以平均 8.95 美元買進 4 萬股，金額約 36 萬美元；分析師目標價區間 12 至 21 美元。風險：InvestingPro 認為股價相對公允價值偏高、入住率與人力成本、債務負擔。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Brookdale Senior Living is one of the largest US senior-living and care operators. Why it is ignored: at about $8.95 it sits near its 52-week low of $8.79 and about 48% below its high of $17.09. What is changing: director C. Christian Winkle bought 40,000 shares through a trust on November 10 at an average of $8.95, about $358,000; analyst targets range from $12 to $21. Risks: InvestingPro rates it above fair value, plus occupancy, labor costs and debt. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 不是每一筆「內部人買進」都有同樣意義。例如 Matador Resources（MTDR）董事長兼執行長 Foran 在 11 月 10 日買進 2,500 股、約 12.3 萬美元，但報導指出是透過員工持股計畫，資訊量比公開市場買進低；相對地，Accenture（ACN）董事長兼執行長 Julie Sweet 在 10 月 26 日買進約 300 萬美元、Lattice（LSCC）執行長 Ford Tamer 在 11 月 4 日買進約 100 萬美元，屬於自己掏錢的公開市場買進。看 Form 4 時，要分辨交易代碼與金額相對於年薪的大小。
en: Not every insider buy carries the same meaning. Matador Resources Chairman and CEO Foran bought 2,500 shares worth about $123,000 on November 10, but the report says it came through an employee stock purchase plan, which carries less information than an open-market buy; by contrast Accenture Chair and CEO Julie Sweet bought about $3.0 million on October 26 and Lattice CEO Ford Tamer about $1.0 million on November 4 with their own money in the open market. When reading Form 4s, check the transaction code and the size relative to annual pay.

zh: 判讀政要揭露的幾個提醒：申報可以晚到交易後 45 天，所以看到的是「過去」的價格；金額只有區間、沒有精確數字；選擇權的履約價與到期日，才是比買賣方向更有資訊的欄位。Capitol Exposed 統計，截至 11 月 2 日當週共有 48 筆申報，其中買進 7 筆、賣出 41 筆；Benzinga 報導眾議員 Rulli 一次揭露 32 筆交易，其中 22 筆逾期。申報量高不等於有訊號，這個頻道只記錄「誰申報了什麼」。
en: Reading politician disclosures: filings can come up to 45 days after the trade, so prices are from the past; amounts are ranges, not exact figures; and the strike and expiry of options carry more information than the buy or sell direction. Capitol Exposed counted 48 filings in the week to November 2, 7 purchases and 41 sales; Benzinga reported Rep. Rulli disclosed 32 trades at once, 22 of them late. A high filing count is not a signal; this channel only records who filed what.

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：市場同時面對「12 月升息幾乎確定」與「AI 龍頭換人」兩件事，但一週下來三大指數都收高，能源、工業、醫療這些傳統類股在帶頭。這代表資金沒有離開，只是換位置；週五被賣的是 AI 硬體與雲端財報股，被買的是防禦與能源。下週有 Warsh、零售銷售、FOMC 會議紀要，還有 Nvidia 與 Walmart 財報。想一想：如果你持有的是 AI 相關股，你原本的賣出條件是價格、財報，還是政策？
en: The one thing worth noting today: the market faces both a near-certain December hike and a change at the top of the AI leader, yet all three indexes rose on the week, led by traditional sectors such as energy, industrials and health care. Money did not leave; it moved. Friday's sellers hit AI hardware and cloud earnings stocks while defensives and energy were bought. Next week brings Warsh, retail sales, the FOMC minutes, and Nvidia and Walmart earnings. Think: if you hold AI-related stocks, is your exit rule based on price, earnings or policy?
